description: This Python script generates and saves an enhanced OpenAPI schema for the backend API of the sports live stream platform. It imports the main application object, retrieves and modifies the schema with additional metadata, server info, security schemes, and example responses, then writes it to a JSON file. It also produces an API endpoint summary.

methods.name: generate_openapi_schema()
methods.description: Main function that generates, enhances, saves the OpenAPI schema, and prints a summary.
